packageRules.description: The Broadway reference runners are the visual oracle: their base image pins the GNOME app versions the presets were imported against. Bumping them changes the oracle, so they are updated manually, version-aligned with the source tags in tests/fixtures/gnome-app-catalog.json.

@gjsify/adwaita-web >=0.32.0 breaks preset/icon rendering (Playwright: html[data-protota-ready] never appears, icon-library toBeVisible failures). Re-enabled once the app is adapted to the new API; tracked in the linked issue.
